messages.author: d3aaa07872b9962c
messages.subject: geom_raster and embedFonts
parts: I usually output graphics from ggplot as PDF and then embed nicer-than-unspecified-helvetica fonts using the embedFonts function, which runs a suitable ghostscript command through system to embed the fonts. I've been experimenting with geom_raster, which in general seems very nice and seems to solve the hairline border issue with geom_tile, but after embedFonts, the PDF comes out as a mess: the raster surface seems blurred and appears black and white in Adobe Reader while Sumatra shows the originals colors. Does anyone know what happens here? Is there a magic gs option that will make the problem go away? Or is there another not-routed-through-LaTeX way to embed fonts in a PDF?
